Let $N\ge 4$ be an integer. Determine all values of $N$ for which there exists a simple orthogonal $N$-gon whose consecutive side lengths, in cyclic order, are

$$
1,2,3,\ldots,N.
$$

Here, a simple orthogonal polygon means a non-self-intersecting polygon in which every side is horizontal or vertical and every pair of consecutive sides is perpendicular.
